INSERT INTO theme.ops_streetlight (id, lamp_count, status, lamp_type, road_type, fixture_height_m, installation_date, entity, geom) VALUES
(#{r.id}, #{r.lampCount}, #{r.status}, #{r.lampType}, #{r.roadType}, #{r.fixtureHeightM}, #{r.installationDate}, #{r.entity}, )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO theme.ops_bus_stop (id, gtfs_id, code, name, name_ar, stop_number, point_type, geom) VALUES
(#{r.id}, #{r.gtfsId}, #{r.code}, #{r.name}, #{r.nameAr}, #{r.stopNumber}, #{r.pointType}, )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE theme.${table} x SET community_key = c.community_key, district_key = c.district_key, municipality_code = c.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_community c WHERE x.geom IS NOT NULL AND c.geom && x.geom AND ST_Intersects(c.geom, x.geom); UPDATE theme.${table} x SET district_key = d.district_key, municipality_code = d.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_district d WHERE x.district_key IS NULL AND x.geom IS NOT NULL AND d.geom && x.geom AND ST_Intersects(d.geom, x.geom)
